issues: Static validation failed; the run cannot be approved until they pass.

wrong_tests.reason: The UI flow checker uses `page.waitForURL((u) => u.pathname.includes(step.url))`. A URL's `pathname` never contains a hash fragment, so the step can never succeed even though the app correctly navigates to `/services#training` and scrolls to the target. The task requires hash navigation to work, which the implementation does, so the test’s expectation is incorrect.
wrong_tests.fix: The test should compare against the full URL (including `hash`) or use `page.url()`/`location.href` to verify the hash part, rather than checking only `pathname`.

feedback: All acceptance tests pass and the implementation meets the listed requirements. The only failing check is due to an inaccurate UI flow test regarding hash navigation. No code changes are needed.
